title: The Foundation of All Good Qualities (yon tan gzhir gyur ma)
summary: Tsongkhapa's short lamrim prayer: devotion to the teacher as the root, the precious human life, death, the lower realms and refuge, karma, the faults of saṃsāra, the vows, bodhicitta, the perfections, calm and insight, and the tantric path.

title: Lamp Thoroughly Illuminating the Five Stages (rim lnga rab tu gsal ba'i sgron me)
summary: Tsongkhapa's exposition of the Guhyasamāja completion stage according to Nāgārjuna's Pañcakrama (isolations, illusory body, clear light, union).

title: Collected Topics (bsdus grwa)

title: Types of Mind (blo rig)
summary: The genre of Gelug textbooks classifying awareness (valid and non-valid cognition, the seven types of mind, mental factors) as the second stage of the debate curriculum.

editions.name: various monastic editions

title: Types of Reasons (rtags rigs)
summary: The genre of Gelug textbooks on correct and incorrect reasons (signs), their modes and divisions, following Dharmakīrti.

editions.name: various monastic editions

summary: The monastic textbooks on which debate in each college is based — those of Jetsün Chökyi Gyaltsen (Sera Je, Ganden Jangtse), Panchen Sönam Drakpa (Drepung Loseling, Ganden Shartse) and Jamyang Shepa (Drepung Gomang) — commenting on the five great texts.

editions.name: college editions

notes: Assignment of textbook authors to colleges recalled; Sera Me's textbook author is not recorded here.

title: Migtsema (dmigs brtse ma)
summary: The short praise-prayer to Tsongkhapa as the union of Avalokiteśvara (compassion), Mañjuśrī (wisdom) and Vajrapāṇi (power), recited as a name-mantra.
